title: Risk diversification for infinitely divisible distributions
abstract: arXiv:2609.25452v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this paper, we study the diversification properties of convex combinations of iid random variables with infinitely divisible distributions. We characterize, in terms of subadditivity and concavity of the transformed L\'{e}vy measures, L\'{e}vy processes that exhibit the non-diversification phenomenon or the reverse diversification order with respect to the majorization order uniformly over all time horizons. In particular, we show that the symmetric 1-stable L\'{e}vy process is the only symmetric L\'{e}vy process exhibiting the non-diversification phenomenon. We further investigate convex combinations of components of multivariate infinitely divisible distributions, allowing for dependent and heterogeneously distributed risks, and characterize the L\'{e}vy measures of the corresponding multidimensional L\'{e}vy processes exhibiting the two diversification phenomena uniformly over time. translated_title: 无穷可分分布的风险分散
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有无穷可分分布的独立同分布随机变量的凸组合的分散化性质。我们通过变换后Lévy测度的次可加性与凹性，刻画了在所有时间范围上一致地表现出非分散化现象、或关于优于序呈现逆向分散化序的Lévy过程。特别地，我们证明了对称1-稳定Lévy过程是唯一表现出非分散化现象的对称Lévy过程。我们进一步研究了多元无穷可分分布各分量的凸组合，允许风险之间具有相依性和异质分布，并刻画了相应多维Lévy过程在时间上一致地表现出这两种分散化现象的Lévy测度，并获得了显式刻画。
tldr: 本文通过变换后Lévy测度的次可加性与凹性刻画了无穷可分分布在所有时间范围上一致的非分散化与逆向分散化现象，证明对称1-稳定Lévy过程是唯一表现出非分散化现象的对称Lévy过程，并将结果推广到相依异质风险的多维情形。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes Lévy processes exhibiting non-diversification or reverse diversification uniformly over all time horizons via subadditivity and concavity of transformed Lévy measures, proves that the symmetric 1-stable Lévy process is the only symmetric Lévy process showing the non-diversification phenomenon, and extends the results to multivariate infinitely divisible distributions with dependent and heterogeneously distributed risks.
